name: Takatsuki Takehara
source:
The protagonist. He has 3 somewhat loving younger sisters. Since his parents have died it's his responsibility to take care of them and so he works part time. He has the reincarnated soul of the demon king making Nerisu his true sister through magic.

In one scenario it's possible for him to accidentally and permanently be turned into a girl.
